description: Data and alignment checks for the 2013 LCL rebuild (scripts/02_lcl_checks.py). Energies in kWh per household per half-hour unless stated.

slot_mapping.convention: authors' consumption_hh of date d  <->  LCL DateTime d + (hh + shift) * 30 min
slot_mapping.meaning: authors' consumption_hh on date d = mean LCL reading labelled d + hh * 30 min (same date, same clock label; LCL labels are GMT)

our_1032_sum_over_authors_value.note: constant 1007 would mean the same households; it varies, so the sets differ

slot_mapping.authors_value_definition: consumption_hh = arithmetic mean (kWh per household per half-hour) over the 1007 ToU households; the identified subset reproduces it to ~1e-9 kWh on fully observed slots; the cluster files are the per-cluster means (size-weighted mean of the 4 clusters = all-ToU mean)

tariff_alignment.frame: authors' slot frame (consumption mapped with shift +0); d = mean ToU - mean Std (filled, 1032 vs 1032 households)
tariff_alignment.residual: d minus its same-slot median over all-Normal days of the same season; event profiles are additionally corrected by the matched (season, work-day, slot) mean residual of all-Normal days
tariff_alignment.offset_convention: offset o moves every event of the candidate o slots later
tariff_alignment.score: sum over High/Low x START/END of the mean lag-0 step in the expected direction (kWh)

candidates.C: C: Tariffs.xlsx read as London clock time

right_alignment.meaning: a price period starting at London clock time t (converted to GMT) first shows in the LCL reading labelled t +1*30 min, i.e. LCL timestamps label the END of the half-hour
right_alignment.authors_slot_time_meaning: authors' slot h of date d = LCL reading labelled d + h*30 min GMT = consumption of the half-hour ENDING then (slot 0 = 23:30-24:00 GMT of the previous day); in BST months local clock = GMT + 1 h

authors_dummies_vs_right_alignment_jan_o.note: timing identical; the only differences are schedule content on the listed days
